style.title: 精致哥特恐怖音乐剧，B级录像带提供气氛
style.reference: 以MJ《Ghosts》《Thriller》式戏剧性恐怖音乐短片为主要参照，保留现有V6角色和城堡；B级惊悚录像带只提供阴森、陈旧与轻微不安。
style.frame: 2.35:1有效画面，目标1692×720；单镜单幅、画面铺满，不内嵌黑边、字幕或镜号。
style.lighting: 褪色灰蓝月光与少量暗暖烛光，深重阴影保留主体轮廓；酒红、灰蓝、炭黑、旧象牙白构成低饱和底色。红色与蓝色均压暗褪色，避免鲜红、电蓝和金亮反光。
style.materials: 真人化妆、厚丝绒、旧石墙与有重量的骨架道具。保留大块材质和主要轮廓，建筑减少细碎雕花、花纹与重复装饰；画面不堆满烛台、玫瑰和骨架。
style.detail_control: 每镜只有一个视觉重点，局部足够辨认，其余落入柔焦、阴影与烟雾。面孔以眼神和面骨为主，服装保留大玫瑰图形，不追加密集刺绣；远景强调拱顶、柱列和空地，不逐块描画砖石。禁止超清、过度锐化、HDR、满画面微纹理和概念图式细节堆叠。
style.performance: 主角精致、危险而有吸引力，眼神和姿态有戏剧性。骷髅错落、停顿、轻微僵直，每镜少数动作，跟随既定主唱／和声分工。
style.camera: 摄影机有重量，广角展示巨大纵深，近景用面骨、眼神与材质承接情绪；每镜只保留一种主要运镜。
style.finish: 参考图直接呈现旧镜头与录像转录的有限清晰度：整体柔和、细节有损失、暗部合并、高光轻微晕开，保留颗粒与轻微色彩渗出。主体靠轮廓、眼神和光比辨认，不做现代数字超清。动态串色、拖影、噪声与少量破损统一后期控制。
style.continuity: 沿用V6浅金长卷发、瘦削中性成年面孔、冷白皮肤、尖耳、红瞳、荆棘肩领和玫瑰拖尾。入口南、王座北、西侧彩窗、东侧石阶与回廊，城堡中连续表演。

method: built-in image_gen, one independent image per shot

shots.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset: one finished cinematic shot reference for Crimson Throne, a gothic supernatural music film.
FORMAT: exact 2.35:1 ultra-wide landscape canvas, preferably 1692 x 720 pixels. Fill the complete canvas with picture. SINGLE SHOT, SINGLE IMAGE. No letterbox bars, film-strip borders, panels, collage, captions, text, timecode or watermark.
Input image roles: Image 1: vampire identity and costume silhouette ONLY. Image 2: castle geometry and basic materials ONLY. Image 3: subdued palette, vintage softness and grain ONLY; do NOT copy its composition.
PRIORITY OVERRIDE: the reference images are too crisp, colorful and ornamented. Use them for identity, costume silhouette and room geometry ONLY. The following image-density, color and clarity controls OVERRIDE their rendering style.
DETAIL CONTROL: ONE visual focal point per frame. Broad simple masses, uncluttered negative space, sparse props. Preserve major arches and columns but remove busy decorative filigree, dense carved reliefs and repeating tiny patterns. Plain dark stone planes dissolve into shadow and haze. Only a few irregular skeleton silhouettes where required, not packed balcony rows. Sparse candle groups, no hundreds of bright points. Costume uses broad matte black/oxblood velvet and ONE readable large rose motif, no densely repeated rose embroidery. Do not describe every brick, hair strand, skin pore or bone pit.
COLOR CONTROL: strongly reduced color saturation, faded dirty burgundy, smoky gray-blue, charcoal and aged ivory. Red glass and cloth are dark dull wine stains. Moonlight is near-neutral cool gray, NOT vivid cyan or electric blue. Candle light is dim dirty cream, NOT bright orange/gold. Restrained tonal range, subdued highlights, no HDR, no gemstone sparkle, no glossy floor mirror.
CLARITY CONTROL: a frame from an old gothic film transferred to a worn standard-definition videotape. Noticeably soft vintage optics, low microcontrast, faded color separation, merged shadow detail, subtle grain obscuring fine texture, light chroma smearing and gentle highlight bloom. Edges are soft, background details indistinct. Keep composition, facial expression and silhouette readable WITHOUT ultra-sharp rendering. No 4K/8K look, no digital sharpening, no hyper-detailed fantasy concept art. Avoid exaggerated glitch strips, black borders and fake scanline wallpaper.
Global look: sophisticated live-action gothic horror musical from the 1980s/1990s, premium dramatic photography and charismatic theatrical performance, with a restrained undercurrent of eerie B-movie videotape atmosphere. Real skin and practical makeup, substantial velvet costume, tactile worn stone and practical skeletal props. Deep shadow masses, directional pale-gray moonlight through atmospheric haze, dim candle warmth, faded oxblood accents. Visible vintage optical softness and grain; facial structure stays recognizable but surface microdetail is lost. No glossy CGI, digital HDR, cartoon, illustration, heavy video glitches or scanline overlays.
Identity if present: SAME adult androgynous slender vampire from reference 1, sharp narrow face, bloodless cold-white skin, voluminous long pale-golden CURLY hair, visible pointed ears, ruby-red irises, small fangs. Ivory ruffled jabot and loose sleeves, black waistcoat and high-waisted trousers, black/oxblood velvet coat with pointed thorn shoulders and a broad train with a single large simple rose motif; same ornate aged-silver handheld microphone. Never substitute a celebrity face. No new lover or audience.
Castle if present: same immense real interior built from broad restrained stone masses, three levels of dark galleries, simplified rose stained-glass on west wall, dark throne at distant north end, organ integrated high in architecture, east-side stone stairs. No exterior, literal concert stage, risers, footlights or visible modern equipment. Skeletons if present are bare pitted dark-brown bone with no clothing; scattered at varied heights and distances, never a symmetrical choir line. Window light direction must remain believable.
Compose the requested camera angle afresh. One decisive cinematic moment, not an illustration of every action in sequence. Preserve negative space and visual scale appropriate to the shot.
SHOT S01 (序章·城堡苏醒):
Subject: 城堡. Camera: 极远景 / 18mm; intended movement: 高位缓慢前推.
Moment: 先看见黑暗中的三层回廊，主角仅为远处小点；窗光扫过空石地，保留足够空间尺度。
Lighting: 冷月光主导，少量烛火，不加演出灯。
Emotional undercurrent: 神秘、悬疑、不安.
MANDATORY FRAMING: EXTREME ESTABLISHING WIDE: architecture and empty space dominate; any vampire is a tiny speck, at most 4 percent of image height.
MANDATORY CAST: One vampire is visible. NO skeletons or extra figures in this frame.

No written lyrics. Framing and cast requirements override any person or composition visible in the reference images.
